requiredHostControls: Constrain cwd and filesystem access outside Pi.
Select a static tool allowlist before each run.
Treat project-local resources as untrusted unless explicitly approved.
Pass only an explicitly selected provider/model and never inherit credentials accidentally.
Enforce aggregate token/cost/time budgets from streamed usage and lifecycle events.
